audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart is blanket 'Skill 5/10' while content and packet both give Mel 1-2 and Cassiopeia from level 3 onward; also 28 misgendered fields (Cassiopeia is she/her).
audit.why: Content win[] matches the packet levelChart exactly and its whys are kit-grounded: pre-3 Cass has no poison engine; from 3, Miasma (24s, grounds) plus Twin Fang (0.75s, sustain) win extended trades.
audit.corrected: Full phases[0..6].side aligned to content win[], ratings and whys rewritten as one atomic group; every flagged pronoun fixed.

audit.why: Spikes correctly give Cass the 3-5 ramp, the level 6 Petrifying Gaze burst window, and first-item/late DPS dominance; Mel's window is 1-2. All 4 entries present.

audit.whatIsWrong: The reflect framing was wrong for this enemy: of Cassiopeia's spells only Twin Fang carries the projectile flag — Q Noxious Blast, W Miasma and R Petrifying Gaze are not projectiles, yet tldr/winCon/dontsFull sold Rebuttal as answering her rotation.
audit.why: Riot's text: Q is a delayed poison blast, W poison clouds (grounding), R a gaze cone. Rebuttal's reflect applies to projectiles; her core kit walks through the glow.
audit.corrected: tldr, winCon, tradeGood, trading, dontsFull[1].d, dontsFull[2].d and enemyWin rewritten around the true interaction; anti-heal timing already on the page (report[8]).

audit.why: Miasma 24/22/20/18/16s and Petrifying Gaze 120s are the two windows that gate every step-up.
